report_stamp_note: Timestamp printed in the PDF header, Eastern Time (the index labels every link 'ET report'). This is the LEAGUE's revision time.
why_captured: The official index listed a 6:30 AM ET report after the 6:15 AM capture was written. The freshness gate (gate_injury_report_is_newest) is what caught it: the build had been about to run on a superseded document. This file is the superseding capture.

changes.note: The league corrected the spelling of a player's name between revisions. STATUS DID NOT CHANGE. This is reported because a naive diff keyed on player name would read the correction as one player vanishing and another appearing, i.e. as two 'status events', which is exactly the false positive the diff must not produce. The diff key used downstream is (game_date, matchup, player) with the reason carried through so a spelling correction can be recognised, and the two spellings are listed here rather than reconciled silently.

diff_vs_previous.other_rows: All other rows are unchanged between the two revisions, row for row and field for field.
